items.title: The Green Hole in Tokyo
items.task: Why does one of the world’s biggest cities keep this huge green hole in its middle?

choices.response: People did build here. Look older.

choices.text: It is tied to the palace and old Edo Castle
choices.response: Yes. Part of the old castle complex is still here.
Tokyo builds on harder sites than this.
The empty centre is much older than a new park.

items.reveal: The Imperial Palace area occupies part of the former Edo Castle complex.
items.followUp: Find a moat, wall or gate.

moreInfo.title: Part of a castle
moreInfo.text: The palace grounds cover part of the old Edo Castle site. The wide green today does not all have one simple origin.

items.visualIdea: Edo Castle map next to today’s palace green
items.notes: Do not imply the entire green area has one simple origin. Follow-up is find a moat, wall or gate.
